source: DECLARED, not extracted. Growth Factor is the house brand; there was no prior site to mine, so this kernel is stated here and frozen from this point exactly as an extracted one would be.

geometry.note: Zero radius everywhere. Per motion.md this forces linear / sharp-cut motion. Nothing on this site may bounce or spring.

motifs: Mono index numerals (01..09) set large in the offset rail
1px full-bleed hairline rules as the structural divider system
The offset rail: content pinned hard left, mono metadata in the right margin
Hard 0px corners on every container and every action
The signal block: a solid #2F4BFF rectangle used as emphasis, never a gradient
Bracket marks [ ] in mono wrapping every section eyebrow
The ground flip: ink section to paper section as a hard cut, no transition band
